sourceText:
A True Pink Lemonade Cake
By: Celia
Published: Monday, January 11, 2010 - 5:55pm

Ingredients




1 package white cake mix
1 1/2 packages pink lemonade koolaide, unsweetened
Icing:
Vanilla icing (Crisco-based)
1 packages1 to 1 ½ p unsweetened koolaide pink lemonade mix

Preparation

1 Mix cake mix according to directions. Add the koolaide mix. Bake according to directions on box. Cool.  2 Mix your favorite vanilla frosting; add 1 to 1 1/2 packages of the koolaide according to how tart you wish icing to be. Spread on your cake.

About


A friend shared this recipe with me.  She worked to mimic a pink lemonade cake which a local bakery in Winston-Salem sold.  It is a close replica and is very good.  It always gets raves when I make it.  I even had a young lady have me make this flavor for her wedding cake.
